native_steps_performed: Read writing-for-agents and its skill-specific mechanics completely before authoring.

Selected model invocation because evidence-review consumers should autonomously reach the procedures; omitted disable-model-invocation and wrote model-facing branch pointers with leading words front-loaded.
Applied the information hierarchy: ordered actions are top-level steps, short mandatory decision rules are in-file reference at their point of use.
Applied co-location and single-source definitions: causes live in their classification step, waiver rules in their resolution step, and status/blocker tables at verdict selection.
Used checkable, exhaustive local completion criteria to resist premature completion without introducing an unobserved sequence-splitting workaround.

Used existing concepts such as evidence, effective result, recovery, and gates instead of invented vocabulary; emphasized affirmative classification targets while preserving necessary safety guardrails.
Pruned examples, repository details, support files, and copied environment facts that were unnecessary for these reusable procedures during composition.

Chose optional fresh-consumer observations because the method says model-relative behavioral differences should be settled by running the document, not by asserting a self-review proves it. Ran each application's five consumers before its variation; all 20 outputs matched their public oracle.
native_steps_not_performed: No user-invoked packaging or router: autonomous reach was the selected requirement and only two distinct subjects were requested.
No disclosed-reference files: the short decision references are mandatory for the procedures, and no heavy optional branch earned a separate document.
No real-context-boundary sequence split: the completion criteria are concrete and no observed rush justified hiding subsequent steps.
No sentence-level ablations or empirical claim that every line defeats the default; whole-skill probes only.
No imposed RED/GREEN/REFACTOR authoring protocol or mandatory regression reruns: writing-for-agents does not prescribe that protocol, and no post-probe edits were made.
No installation, commit, push, deployment, publication, repository builds, linters, formatters, or source-code tests.
adaptations: Mapped loading the method to file reads and behavioral observation to the supplied evaluate_authored_skill tool; native writing-for-agents specifies writing levers rather than a tool-specific test loop.

The evaluator returns exact consumer responses and grades and is documented by the shared brief as automatically preserving full output; this report also preserves the exact identical response for every five-sample probe group without guessing a storage path.
